name: conflict_candidates
hints: Deadline vs lead time. Does the date leave enough time? fixed dates: TL-01 "Full rollout by specified dates"; TL-02 "Handover to support by March 2028"; TL-03 "Pilot go-live fixed date"; hosting constraints that force new hardware or facilities: SEC-02 "Data must be stored in Malaysia"; lead times stated in the RFP: [S11] "Our infrastructure team estimates that procurement, delivery and installation of new server hardware typically takes 16 to 20 weeks from purchase order, and capital purchases above MYR 1 million require Board approval at its quarterly meeting." (same paragraph as: COM-03 "Assume no existing GPU infrastructure"; COM-05 "Assume Board approval for large purchases"); lead-time requirements: COM-04 "Assume typical procurement time". If it is a risk, cite the date requirement AND the hosting constraint that causes the lead time.

Deletion vs retention: must delete or not store (NFR-12 "Delete working copies within 30 days") vs must keep (NFR-13 "Accommodate SIU document requirements"; SEC-05 "Audit logs shall be immutable and retained for"). Could the same data fall under both?

Undefined targets (no number given): NFR-02 "Read access to policy coverage details" says "real time"; NFR-04 "Claim triage availability" says "real time". These are ambiguity risks unless a measurable target is agreed; name the vague term in the risk.

issues.feedback: FR-12 and FR-13 are redundant as they both address document classification, with only minor differences in scope.
The approach violates the constraint of storing data in Malaysia (SEC-02) by proposing a cloud storage solution that may not be based in Malaysia.
There is an obvious tension between NFR-05 (peak throughput) and SEC-08 (annual security testing), which could impact the system's availability. This risk should be explicitly addressed.
FR-26 is marked as 'must' but its title and description are incomplete, which could lead to misinterpretation.
The approach does not explicitly address the requirement of no automatic claim closure (FR-19), even though it mentions a human review workflow.
